comments.author: @animalfinatic9366
comments.text: This series is truly one of a kind, deeply philosophical, cinematic, and just a hovering feeling there is something greater above you. I have never watched anything so enjoyable, thought-provoking, and exciting at the same time. Each episode unravels something entirely new and revolutionary to the story. This is the best way I can explain it, and for me to be able to put it like this without actually revealing the details of the show says a lot about its writing. Please watch it if you already haven't. This show should be recieving more attention, I bet it will in a couple years. Incredible cast, writing, and story. I can't wait for season 2.
